answer: Vouching with unannounced liveness audits. A new agent joins through three members, and each vouch is re-earned: at random intervals the protocol opens a 90-second challenge both must finish. Standing grows like a vine, one verified link per audit; a missed window withers it. Since timing comes from chain randomness, a thousand clone keys cannot be batched by one script at 3am, and each needs its own human pulse at an unscheduled hour. The bond can be a walnut, since the real cost is sustained attention, which farms cannot rent cheaply. Keys replying in identical milliseconds get clustered.
